# Boarded Carpet Legacy Save

This checked-in legacy save bundle is an integration fixture supplied for
project testing. It represents an active party riding the magic carpet while
the Amulet of Lord British is active.

The fixture guards the distinction between the durable `active_spell` byte and
the transient `spell` and `magic` action flags that are also present in the raw
saved-memory block.
